briefings.engineering: 2/2 DB connections in use, 640/min connection timeouts, p95 4387 ms, HTTP 500 rate 53.5%. Suspect: cfg-2291 by deploy-bot set db.pool.max_size 20 -> 2, 4 min before alerts.
briefings.support: About 54% of checkouts are failing (321/min). Tell customers payments are degraded, a fix is being tested, and to retry shortly.
briefings.commander: SEV-1 on payments-api. Team: Zak, Maya, Alex, Jordan. Timeline: cfg-2291 by deploy-bot set db.pool.max_size 20 -> 2, 4 min before alerts; alerts fired; AI diagnosis and repair auctions running. Your decision: approve a sandbox-tested repair.
briefings.leadership: Payments are 54% degraded: about 321 failed checkouts per minute, roughly $13,482/min in revenue at risk (assumes $42 per order).
